name: Parts Of The Body
overview: Scripture reveals the human body as a unified entity in Christ, where believers are called to support and strengthen one another, reflecting the interconnectedness described in Romans 12:5 and Isaiah 35:3. The Holy Spirit equips and teaches the body through appointed leaders such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers (Ephesians 4:11; John 14:26). Living according to the Spirit rather than the flesh brings freedom from condemnation (Romans 8:1), and believers are exhorted to actively live out God's Word, not merely hear it (James 1:22). Together, these truths emphasize the spiritual vitality and mutual responsibility within the body of Christ.
